comment: The previous note here said the module emits 0V before it first becomes active and that changing the mode abandons a stage in progress. Neither holds in the 2.0.3 source: the engine starts in Input mode, which copies IN to OUT, and identify_mode only reads the mode switch on a gate rise or a DEFER fall, so moving the switch mid-stage changes nothing until the next gate.
